lines.cap: Death and the ghost became roommates. It is not working out.
lines.say: Death and the ghost became roommates. It is not working out.

lines.cap: Boo! Did I scare you? I've been practising!
lines.say: Boo! Did I scare you? I've been practising!

lines.cap: It's three a.m. I have work in the morning. Please.
lines.say: It's three a.m. I have work in the morning. Please.

lines.cap: The ghost keeps haunting the bathroom. Every night. On a schedule.
lines.say: The ghost keeps haunting the bathroom. Every night. On a schedule.

lines.cap: You've been going 'wooOOoo' in the bathroom for two hours.
lines.say: You've been going 'wooOOoo' in the bathroom for two hours.

lines.cap: It has great echo! Listen! WooOOOoo!
lines.say: It has great echo! Listen! WooOOOoo!

lines.cap: Finally, Death puts up a chore chart. And earplugs.
lines.say: Finally, Death puts up a chore chart. And earplugs.

lines.cap: Monday to Friday, you haunt the neighbours. I sleep.
lines.say: Monday to Friday, you haunt the neighbours. I sleep.

lines.cap: Deal. Best roommate I've had in two hundred years.
lines.say: Deal. Best roommate I've had in two hundred years.

lines.cap: Tag your roommate. Death and the ghost moved in together.
lines.say: Tag your roommate. Death and the ghost moved in together.
